purpose: Source-bound decomposition of crash/restart semantics for persistent self-improvement controllers. Published/measured properties are separated from proposed self-improvement-specific extensions.

sources.title: Resume Means Resume: A Machine-Checked Conformance Contract for Checkpoint, Interrupt, and Resume Semantics in Workflow Persistence Layers
sources.scope: workflow persistence/resume semantics; deterministic fault harness including real SIGKILL; TLA+/TLAPS reference contract

sources.title: DART: Semantic Recoverability for Structured Tool Agents
sources.scope: dependency/effect-aware semantic admissibility of rollback targets in structured tool agents

sources.title: Crab: A Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore Runtime for Agent Sandboxes
sources.scope: OS/sandbox checkpoint granularity and recovery correctness below the agent/workflow semantic layer
durable run checkpoint state including accounting and public resume/rewind semantics

resume_plane.evidence_boundary: The paper separates ordinary exception probes from real SIGKILL and uses an external durable effect ledger. It reports that some framework/API resume semantics that look correct under interrupts become at-least-once under crash, and that consume-once can fail under concurrent cross-process resume. These are workflow/runtime semantics, not proof of self-improvement semantic validity.

required_checks: no conflict with committed downstream work
semantic_rollback_admissibility.scope_guard: This supports semantic rollback selection under DART's reviewed dependency/effect policies. It does not establish a universal admissibility oracle or a common-budget self-improvement controller comparison including Continue and strategy redirect.

sandbox_state_recovery.evidence: Crab reports that more than 75% of turns produce no recovery-relevant sandbox state; semantics-aware checkpoint selection raises reported recovery correctness from 8% to 100%, cuts checkpoint traffic by up to 87%, and stays within 1.9% of fault-free execution time in its tested scope.
sandbox_state_recovery.scope_guard: This is below the workflow/controller semantic layer and does not decide which self-improvement lineage or rollback target is semantically admissible.

persisted_fields: loop previous/current snapshots and budget marks
controller_accounting_durability.implementation: buildCheckpoint persists budget tokens/cost/iterations/elapsed/unpriced accounting plus CostUSDTotal; restoreBudgetAccounting restores consumed accounting on resume instead of granting a fresh allowance.
controller_accounting_durability.test: TestResumeFromFailure_BudgetSpendRestored sets a workflow max cost of 1.0 and a checkpoint with 5.0 already spent; resume must fail BUDGET_EXCEEDED before the restart node executes, preserving failed_resumable state.
controller_accounting_durability.rewind_semantics: Public documentation states rewind preserves budget accounting and loop counters, retains artifact versions and append-only event history, and uses CAS to avoid concurrent resume/rewind races.
controller_accounting_durability.important_limit: The public checkpoint restores outputs/controller accounting, not arbitrary uncommitted workspace files; Git/persisted artifacts remain the durable workspace authority. No complete arbitrary-SIGKILL equivalence matrix over controller state was found in this run.

evaluation_consumption_transaction.motivation: Self-improvement consumes evaluation queries, emits selection feedback, spends statistical risk/wealth and may promote or reject artifacts. Crash/retry can silently duplicate or refund these effects even when workspace/model state resumes correctly.
proposed_properties: Every evaluation query has a durable unique id bound to candidate/incumbent artifact identities and evaluation snapshot.
Query issuance/score observation/feedback emission/statistical spend/promotion decision are monotone auditable state transitions.
A crash cannot invisibly reissue a consumed evaluation, erase an unfavorable score, refund query or error budget, or re-emit richer feedback without an explicit retry policy and audit record.
Resume/rewind preserves or explicitly invalidates evaluation-consumption state under a transaction id; selection-unused outer tests remain unconsumed until final evaluation.
Statistical candidate-local evidence and any cross-candidate spending are restored from durable state before further proposals are evaluated.
evaluation_consumption_transaction.scope_guard: This contract is a derived research hypothesis from the observed gap; it is not claimed as a published theorem or validated implementation.

minimum_recovery_stack_hypothesis: semantic rollback admissibility before choosing a restore target
immutable/versioned artifact identity and complete action chronology
composition.missing_whole_system: No public real-LLM self-improvement system was confirmed in this run to combine all layers with kill injection across controller transaction phases, common-budget Continue/whole-restart/artifact-preserving-rewind/strategy-redirect comparison, and an outer test unused by selection/rollback/routing/stopping.

next_falsification.reference_run: Execute uninterrupted controller lineage and record immutable artifacts, effects, budget, evaluation queries, statistical spend, action/proposal chronology and outer result.
next_falsification.kill_sweep: Inject SIGKILL at each durable phase boundary and selected interior points, then resume from durable state only.
equivalence_checks: evaluation query ids and score-consumption ledger
